Container.Name: newznab-rss-indexer
Container.Overview: A Newznab-compliant indexer that proxies a searchable RSS feed. Add it to Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, or NZBHydra2 as a generic Newznab indexer. Includes a web GUI for status and quick search testing.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and Newznab API

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage. Optionally place a config.py here to override any setting without rebuilding the image.

Config.Name: Indexer Name
Config.Description: Display name shown in the web UI and to client apps

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: API key that Sonarr/Radarr/etc. must supply as ?apikey=... Change this from the default.

Config.Name: RSS Search URL Template
Config.Description: Your searchable RSS feed's URL. {query} is replaced with the URL-encoded search term.

Config.Name: Category Map Override (JSON, optional)
Config.Description: Optional JSON object mapping your feed's category text to Newznab category IDs, e.g. {"anime": 5070}
